app.name: 3D WMS
app.tagline: Warehouse management with a live 3D view
home.body: Set up your warehouses and draw their floor plans under Warehouses. The 3D view and stock arrive in the next versions.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password from your invite.
login.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.passwordSet: Your password is set. Sign in to continue.
invite.title: Set your password
invite.subtitle: Choose a password with at least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
invite.noToken: This page needs the full invite link. Ask your admin to send it again.
account.title: My account
account.changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
account.sessionsBody: Lost a phone or used a shared computer? Sign out everywhere, including here.
users.title: Users
users.col.name: Name
users.disableConfirm: Disable {name}? They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until enabled again.
invite.dialog.title: Invite a user
invite.dialog.body: You get a link to send them by WhatsApp or SMS. It works once, for 72 hours.
invite.dialog.name: Full name
invite.link.title: Invite link for {name}
invite.link.body: Send this link to them now. It is shown only once and expires on {date}.
rename.title: Change name
rename.name: Full name
roles.dialog.title: Roles for {name}
roles.dialog.hint: Changes apply at once, even on devices where they are signed in.
roles.title: Roles
roles.body: What each built-in role can do. Give a person several roles if they do several jobs.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: Every change and sign-in in your company, newest first.
error.AUTH_FAILED: Email or password is not correct, or the account is locked for a while.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
error.CSRF_INVALID: The page was open too long. Reload and try again.
error.INVITE_INVALID: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.
error.EMAIL_IN_USE: This email already has an account.
error.ROLE_UNKNOWN: One of the roles no longer exists. Reload and try again.
error.LAST_ADMIN: Your company must keep at least one active Tenant admin.
error.CANNOT_DISABLE_SELF: You cannot disable your own account.
error.NOT_INVITED: This user has already set a password.
error.PASSWORD_INCORRECT: Your current password is not correct.
error.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a password different from the current one.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
error.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
notFound.title: Page not found
warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.newHint: Sizes in metres. The floor starts as a rectangle; reshape it in the layout editor.
warehouses.col.name: Name
warehouses.archiveConfirm: Archive {code}? It disappears from all lists and frees a place in your plan. Its history is kept.
warehouses.codeRule: Capital letters, digits and dashes, up to 20
layout.conflict: Someone else saved this layout while you were editing.
layout.label: Label
layout.help: Drag the blue corners to shape the floor. Double-click a wall to add a corner, right-click a corner to remove it. Draw zones, then place racks inside them: drag to move (snaps to 0.1 m), R turns the selected rack, Delete removes it. Red racks overlap or stick out of their zone; amber ones face a too-narrow aisle. Scroll to zoom, drag the background to move.
layout.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes to this layout. Leave without saving?
error.PLAN_LIMIT: Your plan has no free warehouse. Archive one or upgrade the plan.
error.CODE_IN_USE: Another warehouse or rack type already uses this code.
error.LAYOUT_CHANGED: Someone else saved this layout. Reload to see their changes.
error.LAYOUT_INVALID: The layout has problems that must be fixed first.
error.NO_DRAFT: There are no changes to publish.
error.WAREHOUSE_NOT_FOUND: This warehouse does not exist or you do not have access to it.
layout.drawing.title: Drawing the floor outline
layout.drawing.help: Click to place each corner (snaps to 0.1 m). Double-click or press Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
layout.drawing.CROSSING: The outline crosses itself. Cancel and draw it again, corner by corner around the building.
layout.corners.hint: Type measured positions for an exact outline. X runs right, Y runs down from the top-left.
layout.rack.needZone: Draw a zone first: racks stand inside zones.
layout.drawing.OUTSIDE: Every zone corner must be on or inside the floor.
layout.name: Name
layout.zone.hint: Drag the square handles to reshape the zone. The code starts every bin code in it, e.g. {code}-R01-01-01.
layout.live.bad: {n} racks overlap or are outside their zone.
layout.live.narrow: {n} racks face an aisle narrower than the minimum.
